alternatives.name: CORE_RUNTIME_VENDOR_SDK
tradeoffs: Would place moomoo-api, pandas, and broker sockets inside the stdlib foundation, breaking Phase 0 import analysis and replay determinism.

alternatives.name: PROCESS_BOUNDARY_OBSERVATIONAL_ADAPTER
tradeoffs: Live bytes remain outside admitted research datasets until a later ADR.
Requires an optional SDK process and serialized canonical events.

negative: Ordinary CI must remain green without OpenD.
Captured live observations are not automatically admitted research datasets.
Moomoo remains one provider; lanes must request canonical capabilities, not vendor products.
positive: Read-only observational market data can be characterized, captured, quality-checked, and replayed.
Vendor SDK stays outside the CPython 3.11 stdlib foundation.
Live observational data, admitted research datasets, paper execution, and live execution remain distinct.

decision.summary: Authorize a controlled, read-only observational live-data boundary. Moomoo OpenD on 127.0.0.1 is the first characterized provider. Canonical core consumes serialized events only. Capture is not admission. Paper and live execution remain forbidden.
decision.title: Observational live market-data boundary (read-only)

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: This ADR does not authorize paper execution, live order submission, unlock_trade, fund movement, paid market-data purchases, options/futures entitlement changes, crypto research implementation (PI14+), prediction-market integration, or automatic admission of live observations as research datasets.
